env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

# A write into a const slice that holds no map faults at run time, because constant data with pointers lives in read-only memory.
logos build -o $WORK/bin/wfault$GOEXE .
! exec $WORK/bin/wfault$GOEXE store
stderr 'unexpected fault address'
! exec $WORK/bin/wfault$GOEXE increment
stderr 'unexpected fault address'
! exec $WORK/bin/wfault$GOEXE copy
stderr 'unexpected fault address'
! exec $WORK/bin/wfault$GOEXE copy-reslice
stderr 'unexpected fault address'
! exec $WORK/bin/wfault$GOEXE clear
stderr 'unexpected fault address'
! exec $WORK/bin/wfault$GOEXE store-nested
stderr 'unexpected fault address'

# An append to a const slice allocates a new array and leaves the constant alone.
exec $WORK/bin/wfault$GOEXE append
stdout '^append \[1 2 3 4\] \[1 2 3\]$'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/wfault

go 1.27

-- main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
)

type row struct {
	N int
	V []int
}

const L = []int{1, 2, 3}

const R = []row{{N: 1, V: []int{4, 5}}}

func main() {
	switch os.Args[1] {
	case "store":
		L[0] = 9
	case "increment":
		L[1]++
	case "copy":
		copy(L, []int{7})
	case "copy-reslice":
		copy(L[1:], []int{7})
	case "clear":
		clear(L)
	case "store-nested":
		R[0].V[0] = 9
	case "append":
		s := append(L, 4)
		fmt.Println("append", s, L)
	}
	fmt.Println("no fault", L, R)
}
